description:
WHY does the underground sanctum vibrate at the exact frequency of human brainwaves?

Acoustic testing inside the monolithic Garbhagriha reveals natural resonant frequency peaks at 110 Hz and 111 Hz—frequencies scientifically shown to alter prefrontal cortex brain activity. Was it intentional acoustic architectural design or accidental geology?

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
